crossRefs.note: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
I and the Father are one.”
Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God, and was going to God,
even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know…
Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is…
For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,
in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,

translations.web: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.
translations.bsb: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you.
translations.kjv: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
translations.asv: All things whatsoever the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he taketh of mine, and shall declare it unto you.
